name: Symphony Orchestra
description: Traditional classical and romantic symphonic scoring model. Full four-family acoustic balance: strings carry pads, counterlines and octave doubling; woodwinds answer in the windows between brass stabs; brass delivers harmonic weight; percussion anchors entrances. Budget: at most 7 concurrent layers (functional roles such as pad, counterline, bass, fill, stab, percussion, color). Energy clamp [0.25, 0.85] — the ceiling is a hard constraint, the floor is a soft directive. Roster roles and ranges come from the app instrument table (ranges.ts); no template-side range hints are needed.
